Get speeches and other turns

Source: R/query-speeches.R
get_speeches.Rd

Returns turns (actions) from the v_speech view, the substantive turns of debate, filtered by research criteria. Each row is one turn, with its sitting, its speaker and the speaker's party at the time.

Usage

get_speeches(
  member = NULL,
  party = NULL,
  parliament_id = NULL,
  chamber = NULL,
  chamber_venue = NULL,
  from = NULL,
  to = NULL,
  type = c("speech", "question", "answer"),
  include_presiding = FALSE,
  include_text = TRUE,
  columns = NULL,
  collect = TRUE,
  limit = NULL
)

Arguments

member

Character vector of member PHIDs. A PHID that matches no member is an error; look one up with find_member().

party

Party ids (numbers) or party names or abbreviations (strings); see Details.

parliament_id

Filter on the sitting's parliament_id: a vector of values or in_range().

chamber

"house" and/or "senate", in any case.

chamber_venue

Filter on the turn's chamber_venue: a vector of values or in_range().

from, to

Sitting-date bounds, inclusive: a year (covering the whole year), a Date, or a "YYYY-MM-DD" string. NULL leaves that end open.

type

Turn types to return: any of "speech", "question", "answer" and "interjection". Defaults to all but "interjection".

include_presiding

If TRUE, also return presiding-officer turns.

include_text

If TRUE (the default), add the content column. Results with content are held to the lower size ceiling, getOption("ausparl.max_rows_text").

columns

Character vector of columns to return; NULL returns all.

collect

If TRUE (the default), return a tibble; if FALSE, a lazy table for further dplyr work.

limit

Maximum number of rows to return, or NULL for no limit.

Value

A tibble with one row per turn and columns action_id, sitting_id, date, chamber, chamber_venue, parliament_id, PHID, name_raw, party_id_at_time, party_at_time, is_speech, is_question, is_answer, is_interjection, is_non_speech, is_petition, is_motion_no_speech, has_quote, and content when include_text = TRUE. Rows are not in any set order. Zero rows if nothing matches; a lazy table if collect = FALSE.

Details

Turn types. type is resolved over flag columns, never action_type: "speech" keeps rows with is_speech, "question" is_question, "answer" is_answer and "interjection" is_interjection, combined with OR. A row with is_interjection = TRUE is left out unless "interjection" is in type, even when another requested flag is also set. So by default no interjections are returned; type = "interjection" returns only interjections.

Quoted passages. v_speech also holds action_type = "quote" rows: a passage read into the record. None of the four type flags is set on them, so they are never returned here; read them with get_actions() (action_type = "quote"). A quote that names no reader has a missing (NA) resolution.

Presiding officers and speakers who are not one member. Turns by the presiding officer (resolution = "sentinel" in actions) have no PHID and are left out unless include_presiding = TRUE. These turns also have no PHID, and are kept with PHID and the party columns NA:

  • resolution = "unmatched": a named speaker who could not be matched to a member.

  • "unknown": the source records the speaker as unknown.

  • "collective": a group speaking together, such as the Opposition or "Honourable members".

  • "non_member": a speaker who is not a member, such as the Governor-General or a visitor.

A member filter drops all of these.

Party. party_at_time is the speaker's party on the sitting date, and party_id_at_time its party_id. party filters on the party at the time, by id or name, resolved in this order, ignoring case:

  1. A number is a party_id.

  2. A string matching a party's Abbrev or Name exactly selects that party. If it matches several (for example "LIB"), it is an error listing their ids; pass the id instead.

  3. Otherwise a string that occurs in exactly one party's Name selects that party. If it occurs in several (for example "Labor") it is an error listing them, and if in none, an error saying so.

Party lineage is not followed: "ALP" is party 1 only, not its splinter parties. Stored values are returned unchanged.

See also

find_member(), get_sitting_timeline(), get_interjections()

Examples

db_connect(sample = TRUE)
howard <- find_member("john howard")$PHID
get_speeches(member = howard, include_text = FALSE)
#> # A tibble: 5 × 18
#>   action_id      sitting_id date       chamber chamber_venue parliament_id PHID 
#>   <chr>          <chr>      <date>     <chr>           <int>         <int> <chr>
#> 1 house_2002-10… house_200… 2002-10-15 house               1            40 ZD4  
#> 2 house_2002-10… house_200… 2002-10-15 house               1            40 ZD4  
#> 3 house_2002-10… house_200… 2002-10-15 house               1            40 ZD4  
#> 4 house_2002-10… house_200… 2002-10-15 house               1            40 ZD4  
#> 5 house_2002-10… house_200… 2002-10-15 house               1            40 ZD4  
#> # ℹ 11 more variables: name_raw <chr>, party_id_at_time <int>,
#> #   party_at_time <chr>, is_speech <lgl>, is_question <lgl>, is_answer <lgl>,
#> #   is_interjection <lgl>, is_non_speech <lgl>, is_petition <lgl>,
#> #   is_motion_no_speech <lgl>, has_quote <lgl>
get_speeches(party = "ALP", from = 2002, to = 2002, columns = c("date", "name_raw"))
#> # A tibble: 70 × 2
#>    date       name_raw             
#>    <date>     <chr>                
#>  1 2002-10-15 Latham, Mark, MP     
#>  2 2002-10-15 Corcoran, Ann, MP    
#>  3 2002-10-15 Smith, Stephen, MP   
#>  4 2002-10-15 O'Connor, Brendan, MP
#>  5 2002-10-15 Hatton, Michael, MP  
#>  6 2002-10-15 Hatton, Michael, MP  
#>  7 2002-10-15 Wilkie, Kim, MP      
#>  8 2002-10-15 Snowdon, Warren, MP  
#>  9 2002-10-15 Albanese, Anthony, MP
#> 10 2002-10-15 Macklin, Jenny, MP   
#> # ℹ 60 more rows
get_speeches(type = "interjection", chamber = "senate", limit = 5)
#> # A tibble: 5 × 19
#>   action_id      sitting_id date       chamber chamber_venue parliament_id PHID 
#>   <chr>          <chr>      <date>     <chr>           <int>         <int> <chr>
#> 1 senate_1918-0… senate_19… 1918-09-19 senate              1             7 JZ9  
#> 2 senate_1918-0… senate_19… 1918-09-19 senate              1             7 JZ9  
#> 3 senate_1918-0… senate_19… 1918-09-19 senate              1             7 JZ9  
#> 4 senate_1918-0… senate_19… 1918-09-19 senate              1             7 JYT  
#> 5 senate_1918-0… senate_19… 1918-09-19 senate              1             7 KKZ  
#> # ℹ 12 more variables: name_raw <chr>, party_id_at_time <int>,
#> #   party_at_time <chr>, is_speech <lgl>, is_question <lgl>, is_answer <lgl>,
#> #   is_interjection <lgl>, is_non_speech <lgl>, is_petition <lgl>,
#> #   is_motion_no_speech <lgl>, has_quote <lgl>, content <chr>
db_disconnect()
